advice.roomRead: Roster 8: Picks 53; TE:high with no TE and WR:high. Roster 6: Picks 55; TE:high, QB/WR already set, RB or TE only. Roster 2: Picks 59 and 62; TE:high with zero TEs and four RBs.
advice.strategy: RB-heavy build with both starting WRs and FLEX filled; now buy the last separating TE before the tier-3 cliff, then take QB and WR value at the 69/72 turn.
advice.firstSeedDeviationReason: Reaching 8 ranks past Flowers to secure the last realistically available separating TE for an empty starting slot facing a 10.6-point cliff.
advice.strongestAlternativeWhy: Zay Flowers is First Seed's #52, exactly on the pick, and projects 144 versus Warren's 116.8.
advice.strongestCounterargument: Tucker Kraft is the same TE tier 3 at 72.3% survival and 116.3 proj — essentially identical to Warren's 116.8 — so the tier survives to pick 69 in 76.3% of runs and we can take Flowers-class WR value now.
advice.whyRecommendationStillWins: Kraft at 72.3% still fails 27.7% of the time, and if he goes we drop 10.6 points to tier 4 with no TE fallback; the WR we'd buy instead is fungible — tier 8 has seven members, 93% that at least one survives, and a third WR is only a FLEX body behind Judkins.
advice.expectedNextPickPlan: At 69/72 take a QB from tier 3 (Hurts 77.7%, Daniels 61.7%) plus a WR — McLaurin, Egbuka or Evans project 38-16% to be there.
